Container.Name: HAMAL
Container.Overview: HAMAL is a private, self-hosted LAN file and temporary clipboard transfer service. Create temporary rooms, connect devices with QR codes, transfer files directly across your local network, or use the room-scoped Text / Clipboard channel for commands, terminal output, logs, configuration, URLs, and plain text. Optional PIN protection and automatic room expiration keep transfers temporary and private.
Container.Changes: v0.8.14 - Security and reliability release: upload storage limits are now enforced correctly across concurrent uploads, small API requests are size-limited, only the room creator can close a room, PINs are 4-8 digits, participant details stay hidden until the PIN is entered, the upload queue reports errors and keeps going, shared text keeps its exact formatting, and fonts are bundled so pages make no third-party requests.
